hero.lead: A nation of 26.6 million on the Korean Peninsula, closed to most international finance, where forest covers 64% of the land and six in ten people have electricity.

capital.heading: A nation outside the capital markets.

record.text: Total cost of the World Food Programme’s interim country strategic plan for the DPRK, 2019 to 2025, after revision 04 of 8 July 2024; no WFP distribution since March 2021
Vaccine doses delivered to the DPRK by UNICEF on six chartered flights in 2025, with Gavi support

register.name: Vaccines for routine immunisation, 2025
register.detail: UNICEF with Gavi, the Vaccine Alliance · 3.3 million vaccine doses on six chartered flights in 2025 · cold chain equipment · reported 19 December 2025
register.note: 99 per cent of the 2022 to 2025 birth cohorts who had missed their routine vaccinations were fully immunised
register.text: Vaccines against hepatitis B, measles and rubella and polio, and the pentavalent vaccine, procured by UNICEF with Gavi support, flown into the DPRK and given by national implementation partners, with new cold chain equipment for storage and distribution. Supplies resumed in July 2024, when more than four million doses arrived. It serves the health standard.

register.name: UNICEF country programme for the DPRK
register.detail: UNICEF Executive Board, second regular session 2025 · one-year extension, January to December 2026 · fifth consecutive extension · programme in place since 2017
register.note: Extended in step with the United Nations Strategic Framework for the DPRK, by agreement between the UN Resident Coordinator’s Office and the Government
register.text: The programme of cooperation of UNICEF in the DPRK, in place since 2017 and extended by the UNICEF Executive Board for a fifth consecutive year, to December 2026. In 2024 and 2025 UNICEF delivered vaccines and cold chain equipment to the country, serving the health standard; the extension document states no budget.

register.name: WFP interim country strategic plan, 2019 to 2025
register.detail: World Food Programme · revision 04, issued 8 July 2024 · extended to 31 December 2025 · total cost $285,058,941, up $37.3 million · 6,025,858 beneficiaries planned in all
register.note: No WFP assistance has been distributed since March 2021, when the last WFP and UN international staff left the country
register.text: The needs-based plan of the World Food Programme for the DPRK: nutrition support for children in nurseries, kindergartens and boarding schools and for pregnant and breastfeeding women and girls, local food production and fortification, and disaster risk reduction. WFP reports no distribution and no international presence in the country since March 2021. It bears on the food standard.
